recommendation.reason: Synthetic two-stream saturation: fixed batch K=2 inflates backpressure drops; adaptive batch K throttles under congestion without pinning batch K to 1.
Synthetic twostream stress: prevents interactive drops under saturated batch backlog.

Synthetic overload: even when MTP can improve service/throughput, draft work can increase queue pressure; prefer stop_at_reject for safer overhead under low accept, and validate interactive SLA + verify-phase starvation on real traces before enabling.
Synthetic low-congestion regime: MTP helps when accept_rate is high enough to amortize draft cost; validate on real traces before enabling.
